quarterly_data.quarter: Resonac (Showa Denko) press release: Resonac to Strengthen Production System for High-Purity (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Resonac will newly launch production of high-purity hydrogen fluoride (HF) gas for semiconductors at its Tokuyama Plant (Shunan City, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan) within 2026; combined with existing production at the Kawasaki Plant, it plans a two-site production system in Japan. The gas is used in semiconductor circuit etching, and the company says demand is increasing in advanced technologies such as cryogenic etching for deep, fine features in three-dimensional, high-density structures driven by data center and AI applications; Resonac says demand is projected to grow and the move strengthens supply capacity in line with growing demand.
quarterly_data.figure: Tokuyama Plant production start within 2026; two-site production system (Kawasaki + Tokuyama)
